fields.mechanism: Vibration damping mechanism from automotive industry used in suspension systems
fields.intervention: Incorporate viscoelastic damping material into the hip prosthesis articulating surface to absorb abnormal loading forces
fields.expected_effect: Reduced mechanical stress on implant components, decreasing wear and loosening that leads to explantation
fields.falsification_test: Accelerated wear testing comparing damped versus conventional articulating surfaces under simulated gait cycles

fields.mechanism: Passive offset restoration through anatomically pre-shaped femoral components
fields.intervention: Develop hip prosthesis with femoral components pre-shaped to match average anatomical offset values for different patient demographics
fields.expected_effect: Improved initial stability and reduced need for revision surgeries by better approximating natural hip biomechanics
fields.falsification_test: Measure offset restoration accuracy and complication rates in patients receiving pre-shaped components versus custom-made components
fields.mechanism_source_span: "the restoration of biomechanical parameters of the hip-specifically leg length discrepancy (LLD), femoral offset (FO), acetabular offset (AO), and global offset (GO)"

fields.mechanism: Restoration of femoral offset to prevent instability and mechanical failure

fields.expected_effect: Reduced incidence of explanted hip prostheses by minimizing mechanical instability and failure
fields.falsification_test: Compare explant rates between prostheses with and without precise offset measurement in a randomized controlled trial
fields.mechanism_source_span: "failure to restore femoral offset has been implicated as a contributor to instability and mechanical failure"
